data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $60,654,000 there is a deterioration of $5,306,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2020: release $1,052,000).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of $13.504 million in prior year reserves for the 2019 underwriting year, as derived from the claims development triangle. This gross strengthening was influenced by adverse claims development and IBNR recalibration. Despite this, the syndicate reported a net profit of $5.3 million on the 2020 and prior years of account, indicating favorable net development, likely due to reinsurance recoveries or other factors offsetting the gross strengthening.
raw_causal_phrases: deterioration of $5,306,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end
profit on the 2020 and prior years of account of $5.3m
back year deterioration on a GAAP basis
assumptions underlying our reserving methodology reflect additional information obtained from pricing current and prospective business
made a provision within claims that have been incurred at the reporting date but have not yet been reported ("IBNR") in the calendar year to allow for this reserving uncertainty
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount derived from gross claims development triangle for 2019 as narrative text provided a net figure. The report states all business is reinsurance, so the gross premium mix is a single LOB.
